text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is so strong that she's
struggled to
find real competition, which
has awakened a
"hunger" within her. For
her, racing is life.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her debut attracts the attention of the
entire
academy. Some even say she
might have what it
takes to surpass her
older sister, Бива Хаяхидэ.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Some even expect that Brian will win the
Classic
Triple Crown and surpass
Симболи Рудольф, drawing
the attention of
the Emperor herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан's battle in the Twinkle
Series—where
the toughest foes
gather—begins now!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
